title: Single unsafe block isolated in stoa-lmdb FFI boundary crate
description: The unsafe EnvOpenOptions::new().open() call is isolated in crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs and that crate is the only place with unsafe code. Transit, reader, and ctl remain #[forbid(unsafe_code)]. A contributor might suggest inlining the LMDB logic into each daemon to avoid the crate boundary. Don't: the isolation means unsafe audits have exactly one location to check, and the heed SAFETY invariant (single open per path per process) is documented and enforced in one place.
